jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
jobs.description:
**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**


In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.


Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.


Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise\-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.


**Who you will work with**


On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next\-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.


**What makes you a qualified candidate**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of product management experience, including 6\+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air\-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.

**What you will bring**


* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time
* Hands\-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e.g., Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud\-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance\-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next\-generation backup architectures, AI\-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise\-ready.

jobs.title: Applied AI Product Specialist II
jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Specialist II**
 An Applied AI Product Specialist II is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Product Specialist II plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
* Product Accountability
+ Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
+ Drive strategy\-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
+ Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
+ Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
+ Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).

* Vision and Strategy
+ Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
+ Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
+ Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.

* Market and User Engagement
+ Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
+ Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.

* Collaboration and Teamwork
+ Work side\-by\-side with cross\-functional (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
+ Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
+ Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.

* Continuous Improvement
+ Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
+ Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
+ Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force\-multiplier to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
+ Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.

* Applied AI Ways of Working
+ Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—charting new pathways for the business rather than only collecting requirements.
+ Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compressing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chief—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
+ Amplify experimentation: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.


**The successful candidate will possess:**
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


**The team**
 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI\-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this transformation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of proven experience in product management or related roles.
* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Zenopsys** 


 Zenopsys is building a world where life\-saving medicines are never delayed by paperwork and operational bottlenecks. 
 





 Zenopsys is an AI\-native documentation workspace built for the Life Sciences industry. Our platform uses Agentic AI to automate and streamline documentation across the product lifecycle—from
 
**R\&D and Clinical Development to Regulatory Submissions, Quality, and Post\-Market activities** 

 .
 




**We help medicines and therapies reach the market 6\-24 sooner!** 



**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for a highly curious, analytical and customer\-focused Associate Product Manager who can work closely with product, engineering, sales and customers to build and improve Zenopsys products.
 





 You will understand customer workflows and problems, translate them into product requirements, support feature development, conduct product demos, gather customer feedback and help drive product adoption and satisfaction.
 





 The ideal candidate should be a strong problem solver,an excellent communicator, and passionate about building AI\-powered products.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**Product Management** 
* Work with senior product leaders to define, prioritize and build product features.
* Understand customer workflows and convert business problems into clear product requirements.
* Create user stories, feature requirements, acceptance criteria and product documentation.
* Track features from ideation through development, testing, release and adoption.
* Act as the Product Owner for assigned features/modules.


**Customer \& Product Solutions** 
* Understand how customers use Zenopsys for their internal operations and identify opportunities to improve their workflows.
* Conduct customer discussions, capture feedback and translate insights into actionable product improvements.
* Support customer onboarding and product adoption.
* Help resolve product\-related queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Track customer satisfaction, usage and recurring product issues.


**Product Demonstrations \& Sales Support** 
* Become a Zenopsys product expert and develop a deep understanding of the platform and its use cases.
* Conduct product demonstrations for prospects and existing customers.
* Support the Sales/Business Development team during pre\-sales discussions, discovery calls and solution presentations.
* Understand customer requirements and demonstrate how Zenopsys can address their specific business problems.
* Support post\-sales teams with product knowledge, customer training and adoption initiatives.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 
* Work closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Regulatory, Sales, Customer Success and Leadership teams.
* Coordinate across teams to ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and delivered.
* Help create product documentation, SOPs, user guides and training materials.
* Support product launches, feature releases and internal enablement.


**What We Are Looking For** 
* 0–2 years of experience in Product Management, Product Solutions, Solution Engineering, Business Analyst, Consulting, SaaS, Technology or a related role.
* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or related courses from a Tier\-1 engineering institute
* MBA from a Tier\-1 business school with a background in Engineering
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of technology and software products.
* Quick learners who will be able to understand and work with different data types and structures in the life\-sciences industry including scientific data, medical data and regulatory data.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand complex customer problems and simplify them into actionable solutions.


**Good to Have** 
* Exposure to SaaS / B2B software products.
* Basic understanding of APIs, databases, SQL or data analytics.
* Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic workflows.
* Understanding of pharma, biotech, clinical research or regulatory processes.
* Previous experience in customer\-facing or consulting roles.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - CRM Innovation & Experimentation
jobs.description:
**Summary**
 Novartis is on a mission to transform medicine and improve lives worldwide. As a global leader in healthcare, we leverage advanced technology, data, and digital capabilities to deliver patient\-centric solutions, enhance customer engagement, and drive innovation. Within this context, the US CRM organization plays a critical role in shaping the transformation to next\-generation CRM Innovation Labs that identifies and tests opportunities that can improve customer engagement, user experience, productivity, and CRM capabilities. Its work combines structured discovery, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based recommendations.
   

  

 The Senior Manager, CRM Innovation \& Experimentation leads defined innovation opportunities and experiments within the Hyderabad Labs extension. Reporting to the Director, CRM Enablement, Hyderabad, the role partners with the Associate Director, CRM Innovation Labs, US Labs leadership, Product Owners, business teams, technology partners, and control functions to scout emerging possibilities, run prototypes and proofs of concept, coordinate internal and external contributors, and convert learning into decision\-ready recommendations.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Senior Manager \- CRM Innovation \& Experimentation**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**
* Explore business challenges, user needs, product gaps, market trends, and emerging technologies to identify relevant CRM opportunities.
* Scout and assess startups, technology providers, specialist partners, and external capabilities against defined business needs and experiment objectives.
* Triage opportunities to determine whether they require experimentation, can reuse existing CRM capabilities, or should be redirected to another accountable team.
* Shape selected opportunities into clear problem statements, hypotheses, expected benefits, success measures, assumptions, risks, and decision criteria.
* Lead timeboxed discovery, prototyping, proof\-of\-concept, user validation, and technical feasibility activities, ensuring required data, environments, integrations, access, and specialist support are in place.
* Coordinate cross\-functional contributors, including Product Owners, business SMEs, UX, architecture, engineering, data, analytics, privacy, security, legal, compliance, procurement, delivery teams, contractors, and external partners.
* Synthesize user, business, technical, operational, and market evidence into recommendations to advance, pivot, pause, stop, or transition opportunities, including reuse, configuration, process change, or existing\-product enhancement options.
* Maintain strong execution discipline and governance through experiment plans, backlogs, decision records, risks, dependencies, stakeholder updates, transition\-ready documentation, reusable insights, and compliance with responsible\-use, data, privacy, security, legal, procurement, and documentation requirements.


**Essential Requirements**
* Quality and timeliness of opportunity briefs, experiment plans, prototypes, evidence packs, and recommendations.
* Clarity of hypotheses, benefit measures, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and decision records.
* Speed of learning and reduction of business, user, technical, operational, or compliance uncertainty.
* Relevance and quality of external capabilities assessed or translated into experiments.
* Effectiveness of stakeholder and contractor coordination, deliverables, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Quality and readiness of handovers into product roadmaps, operational capabilities, or other agreed adoption pathways.


**Educational Requirement**
 Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, life sciences, engineering, or a related field is required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred
   

  

**Minimum Experience**
* 9\+ years of experience in digital innovation, product management, consulting, technology scouting, prototyping, CRM, or related disciplines.
* Hands\-on experience shaping ambiguous opportunities and leading experiments from hypothesis through evidence\-based recommendation.
* Experience evaluating startups, technology providers, vendors, or external capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional workstreams, contractors, or specialist partners.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder\-management, and execution capabilities.
* Experience working in agile, product\-oriented, global, or distributed environments.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated industry is desirable.


**Desirable Requirement**
**Navigate Complexity** 
 \- Convert ambiguous opportunities into focused experiments and clear decisions.
   

  

**Deliver Collective Impact** 
 \- Coordinate internal teams, contractors, external partners, and control functions toward shared outcomes.
   

  

**Influence Without Authority** 
 \- Build credibility through evidence, demonstrations, user input, and clear recommendations.
   

  

**Drive Ownership \& Execution** 
 \- Manage scope, milestones, dependencies, quality, documentation, and escalation.
   

  

**Continuous Learning** 
 \- Translate emerging trends and experiment lessons into relevant CRM opportunities and reusable practices.
   

  

**Why Novartis:** 
 Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people\-and\-culture

jobs.title: Data Management Lead - Agentic AI for Data
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI\-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud\-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**


The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) at ServiceNow is a customer\-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end\-to\-end, industry\-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end\-to\-end AI\-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de\-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.


You will play a major part in building AI and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that transform the user experience and workflow efficiency of enterprise services. Traditional analytical tools tend to require a technically knowledgeable user to produce even simple results. We are taking a completely fresh approach with the expectation that any user, regardless of technical knowledge, can use the AI/ML solutions we develop to operate the services in the enterprise setting in an thoughtful and scalable manner. We are just getting started with our early\-adopter customers and we need your help in building and making available an amazing range of solutions to our 5k\+ enterprise customers around the world.

* Build the best cloud\-based AI/ML solutions to power intelligent enterprise services
* Collaborate daily with a team of like\-minded developers, product managers and quality engineers to produce quality software
* Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, testing and delivery of high\-quality solutions to our users

 **Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Expertise in Java or Python, OOP, Design Patterns, time and space\-efficient algorithms
* Experience building new products that use challenging algorithms
* Expertise in coding efficient, object\-oriented, modularized and quality software
* Knowledge of core AI/ML techniques and algorithms
* Knowledge of unit testing, profiling, and code tuning

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**


We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**


For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Governance, Ethics \& Performance:

Define performance monitoring, lifecycle metrics, and validation approaches for production AI agents.  
* 

Stakeholder Engagement:

* Present architectural frameworks, solution roadmaps, and AI strategies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

Educational Background:

Ph.D. in relevant domain is a strong plus.

#### **Technical Expertise:**

* Strong communication skills with ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical \& business stakeholders.

* Contributions to open\-source communities, publications, or AI research initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Nextpower is seeking a Senior Supply Chain Analyst to lead the configuration, maintenance, enhancement and day\-to\-day support of supply chain and transportation technology. The role combines deep supply chain and transportation domain knowledge with hands\-on expertise across Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM), supplier\-facing applications, Anaplan and FourKites track and trace. The successful candidate will translate business needs into reliable system solutions, improve operational visibility and help ensure continuity across planning, execution, trade compliance and supplier collaboration.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own functional support and continuous improvement for OTM and GTM, including issue triage, root\-cause analysis, configuration changes, testing and production support.
* Configure and maintain OTM processes for order management, shipment planning, rate and contract management, tendering, carrier collaboration, freight settlement, tracking and execution workflows.
* Configure and support GTM capabilities including product classification, country of origin, duty and tariff determination, landed cost, restricted party screening, sanctions and trade compliance controls.
* Support integrations and data flows between OTM, GTM, ERP, WMS, supplier portal, Anaplan, FourKites and other custom applications. Validate interfaces, monitor failures and coordinate defect resolution.
* Partner with sourcing, logistics, transportation, finance, trade compliance, suppliers and freight forwarders to document requirements and convert them into scalable system solutions.
* Manage changes across development, test and production environments, including release planning, regression testing, UAT support, deployment coordination and post\-release validation.
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, alerts and operational metrics that improve shipment visibility, supplier performance, freight cost control and exception management.
* Create clear functional specifications, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures and user training materials.
* Identify opportunities to simplify manual work, improve data quality, strengthen controls and use system capabilities to support business growth.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience in supply chain, transportation, logistics technology or related operations, with significant experience supporting enterprise supply chain applications.
* Deep hands\-on experience configuring, maintaining and supporting Oracle Transportation Management and Oracle Global Trade Management in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of transportation planning and execution, carrier and freight forwarder operations, tendering, rate management, freight settlement, shipment visibility and trade compliance.
* Practical experience with supplier portals or supplier collaboration applications, Anaplan planning models and FourKites or comparable track and trace platforms.
* Experience with requirements analysis, configuration, test management, UAT, incident/change management and production support.
* Working knowledge of Oracle databases and SQL. Familiarity with OTM/GTM integrations, XML, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware or ERP/WMS interfaces.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication and stakeholder\-management skills. Able to work independently and collaborate across business and technology teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with OTM/GTM Cloud implementations, upgrades, patches, environment migrations or large\-scale enhancement programs.
* Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud, ERP, WMS, S\&OP or supply planning processes.
* Experience supporting global trade programs involving tariff classification, duty and tax analysis, sanctions screening, RPLS/denied\-party screening and audit controls.
* Oracle certification in OTM, GTM or Supply Chain applications.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE**

Success will be measured by stable and responsive application support, accurate and compliant transportation and trade processes, faster resolution of operational exceptions, improved data and integration quality, and measurable adoption of system capabilities across supply chain teams.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.


**We are Nextpower**

**Senior Fullstack Developer – Epiroc Mining India Private Ltd, Bengaluru**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Senior Fullstack Developer in our Research and Development department within the Corporate Units at Epiroc. This role is a pivotal technical position based in Bengaluru, where you'll contribute directly to advancing cutting\-edge offboard automation and connected operations platforms in the mining industry.


### **About the Role**


As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performance applications primarily using WPF, C\#, .NET Core, React 18, and MVVM architecture. Your expertise will be critical in driving innovative software solutions that support sustainable mining operations globally.


You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, QA, and fellow developers to define and deliver features that delight users and meet stringent performance and security standards. Your scope will include both client and server\-side development, integration of RESTful APIs and microservices, and leveraging AI\-driven tools to enhance development efficiency and test automation.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Develop and maintain scalable .NET and ReactJS applications with a focus on high performance, security, and maintainability.
* Lead and mentor junior developers, fostering a collaborative, process\-oriented culture that prioritizes continuous learning and Agile methodologies.
* Drive architectural design and provide technical leadership for distributed systems that leverage networking protocols such as TCP/IP and UDP to ensure scalable and secure communication.
* Implement robust software testing strategies, including automated integration and unit testing using frameworks such as XUnit, NUnit, or MSTest, incorporating AI agents to streamline the SDLC.
* Manage database operations utilizing SQL Server, Entity Framework, and NoSQL technologies for optimal application data handling.
* Coordinate Agile/Scrum processes, potentially acting as Scrum Master, to ensure timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
* Utilize AI coding assistants like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot effectively, incorporating context engineering and agentic workflows to accelerate development.
* Integrate third\-party libraries and external services, ensuring seamless data exchange and system interoperability.
* Identify and implement performance tuning and memory management improvements for smooth application execution.
* Champion secure coding practices aligned with industry standards to protect application integrity and data privacy.
* Collaborate on forward\-looking technical roadmaps and influence architectural decisions that support sustainable innovation and time\-to\-market objectives.

### **Who We're Looking For**


We seek an accomplished developer with a comprehensive skill set across front\-end and back\-end technologies. Your strong command of C\#, .NET Core/.NET Framework, React 18, and MVVM architecture will be foundational to success, complemented by proficiency in XAML, WPF animations, and asynchronous programming.


Experience with AI\-assisted development tools and modern DevOps practices including Git, CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps or Jenkins is essential. You demonstrate strong problem\-solving abilities and thrive in Agile environments with excellent communication and team collaboration skills. Your familiarity with networking protocols and microservices architecture further strengthens your capability to build reliable distributed systems.


### **Why Join Epiroc?**


This position offers remarkable technical visibility, providing the chance to collaborate with global teams and impact the design of next\-generation offboard automation platforms. You will engage in projects driving innovation and shaping the future of connected mining technology, working with scalable, secure, and high\-performance applications that embody Epiroc's commitment to sustainability and excellence.


At Epiroc, we foster a culture of creativity, respect, and continuous improvement, supporting your professional growth while making a tangible difference in the world through technology.


### **Behaviors \& Values**


Successful individuals in this role will exemplify leadership in driving scalable and secure platforms, delivering solutions that are reliable and future\-ready. You operate with deep technical expertise, while actively collaborating across departments to align with Epiroc's strategic innovation and sustainability objectives. Your proactive approach and dedication to quality contribute directly to accelerated time\-to\-market and customer satisfaction.


### **Apply Today**


Become an integral part of Epiroc’s R\&D team and help build software that empowers connected and autonomous mining operations worldwide. If you are passionate about leveraging your fullstack development experience to innovate and lead in a dynamic environment, this opportunity awaits you.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
 Are you passionate about defining how AI assistants and agents securely connect to the systems where organizations keep their knowledge, workflows, and business data?
   

  

 Microsoft 365 Core is building the Copilot Connectors \- the foundation that enables Microsoft 365 Copilot and agentic experiences to discover, understand, and act across enterprise data and applications. Our vision is to make every relevant enterprise system accessible to Copilot through a consistent, secure, and governed platform, while preserving source permissions, organizational controls, and user trust.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly technical
 **Principal Product Manager** 
 to define and drive the next generation of this platform. You will operate at the intersection of product leadership, systems architecture, platform strategy, developer experience, and ecosystem development. You will partner with engineering leaders, architects, security experts, and product teams across Microsoft to shape how first\-party, partner, and customer\-built connectors are developed, onboarded, managed, discovered, and used across Copilot experiences.
   

  

 In this role, you will own the strategy and product direction for a product that supports multiple connector patterns \- including indexed enterprise knowledge, real\-time retrieval, user\-context access, and agent\-driven actions. You will help create a coherent connector experience across Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, agents, and other Copilot surfaces, while simplifying the lifecycle for developers, administrators, and end users.
   

  

 You will shape how connectors authenticate, synchronize, expose tools and data, enforce permissions, and participate in agentic workflows. You will also influence investments across multiple organizations to establish common contracts, governance models, and platform capabilities for connecting Copilot to enterprise systems at hyperscale.
   

  

 This role requires deep technical credibility, solid product intuition, customer obsession, and the ability to align senior leaders across organizations around a shared product and architectural vision.
   

  

 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and drive the long\-term vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform investments for the Copilot Connectors.
* Establish a unified connector model that brings together indexed content, real\-time data access, user\-context retrieval, and agent\-driven actions.
* Shape the end\-to\-end connector lifecycle, including development, validation, certification, publishing, deployment, discovery, configuration, monitoring, updating, and retirement.
* Define how connector capabilities are represented and packaged so customers can access knowledge, tools, and actions through a coherent experience rather than managing fragmented integrations.
* Drive consistent end\-user experiences for connector discovery, authorization, activation, and use across Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, agents, and other Copilot surfaces.
* Simplify administrator experiences for connector deployment, application provisioning, authentication, permissions, synchronization, governance, health monitoring, and compliance.
* Establish platform contracts and architectural patterns for authentication, identity, permission enforcement, data synchronization, schema mapping, retrieval, tool invocation, and action execution.
* Define the strategy for hybrid connectors that combine tenant\-level synchronization with real\-time, user\-authorized access and actions.
* Create intuitive, scalable developer experiences \- including SDKs, APIs, tools, documentation, samples, and validation frameworks \- for first\-party teams, partners, independent software vendors, and enterprise developers.
* Grow a healthy connector ecosystem by reducing time to build and publish connectors, improving quality, and enabling partners to reach customers across Microsoft Copilot experiences.
* Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI teams to ensure connectors are trustworthy, permission\-aware, auditable, resilient, and appropriate for enterprise use.
* Define how connector data and tools are grounded, ranked, cited, and invoked so Copilot delivers relevant, accurate, and explainable outcomes.
* Drive platform capabilities for connector observability, diagnostics, reliability, throttling, freshness, quality measurement, and lifecycle management at hyperscale.
* Work closely with customers and partners to understand their highest\-value systems and scenarios, identify adoption barriers, and translate insights into platform investments.
* Define success metrics across connector coverage, developer velocity, onboarding completion, reliability, content freshness, discovery, activation, usage, answer quality, and customer value.

 Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall’s cloud\-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform, providing enterprise\-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN\-as\-a\-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least\-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high\-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.
 


 The Role
 
 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction.  Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Go\-to\-Market

* Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.


 Required Qualifications
 * 5\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
* Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary**
 Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). At the heart of this is Atmos, Guidewire's "PaaS within SaaS" layer — built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker — that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized core applications, cloud\-native services, and associated workloads.
   

  

 As Senior Platform Product Manager, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for foundational platform capabilities that hundreds of internal engineering teams and external insurer customers build on every day. You'll shape how Guidewire delivers infrastructure as a product — with a focus on developer experience, scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll do**
* We are looking for candidates with 10\+ years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 2–3 years of experience in Product Management
* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for core platform services within CCS/Atmos — spanning areas such as Kubernetes\-based compute, networking, observability, deployment tooling, and shared platform services.
* Gain deep understanding of the Guidewire Cloud ecosystem, the multi\-tenant/hybrid\-tenancy architecture, the market, competition, and the needs of both internal developer teams and external customers.
* Treat platform infrastructure as a product: define capabilities that improve developer productivity, self\-service, and time\-to\-value across the organization.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, SRE/Operations, UX, Sales, Marketing, and Enablement to define and maximize the value of platform solutions.
* Develop pragmatic solutions to complex distributed\-systems and platform problems, collaborating across regions, product areas, and functions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to discover, test, refine, and prioritize solutions.
* Build and communicate roadmaps and requirements with clear use cases, ROI, and acceptance criteria for the appropriate stakeholders.
* Launch new platform services and features, measure their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Be a power user of the platform capabilities you build.
* Champion a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI — leveraging emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**We're Looking For Someone Who**
* Has strong experience building or managing platform / infrastructure products, ideally cloud\-native services offered to internal or external developers ("platform as a product" mindset).
* Has a strong understanding of and hands\-on experience with AWS services (preferably certified as AWS Cloud Practitioner).
* Understands containerization and container orchestration (Docker \& Kubernetes) and the operational realities of running services at scale.
* Is familiar with core platform concerns — networking, observability/monitoring, CI/CD, multi\-tenancy, reliability (SLO/SLA), and cost optimization.
* Can define and articulate product roadmaps with solid use cases and associated ROI.
* Will detail feature requirements/specifications with clear acceptance criteria.
* Can establish a shared vision across the company by building consensus on priorities leading to product execution.
* Will collaborate with engineering and operations teams through design, development, testing, release, and maintenance to ensure quality and successful delivery.
* Can find and lead opportunities for revenue growth, customer adoption, and improved customer satisfaction.
* Is comfortable managing and prioritizing product backlogs to get things done.
* Demonstrates the ability to embrace AI and data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with identity and access management concepts — SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2\.0, SSO, SCIM, and related AuthN/Z patterns — and how they apply to platform services.
* Experience with load balancing and networking in cloud environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner (or higher) certification.
* Familiarity with AHA and JIRA.
* Strong mentoring and coaching experience as a Product Manager.
* Ability to travel 5–10% as needed.


**Role\-specific competencies**
* Customer Need: Comfortable communicating with internal (developer teams) and external customers, understanding their underserved needs and documenting use cases.
* Product Strategy: Ability to distill customer needs, market signals, analyst voice, and SME input into an actionable, pragmatic platform strategy and requirements.
* Collaboration: A multiplier mindset with a demonstrated ability to work across cross\-functional teams.
* Results Driven: A data\-driven PM who stays ahead of market and customer needs.
* Communication: Able to articulate both the technical and business\-value impact of platform investments to Guidewire's goals.
* Motivation: A deep love and appreciation for the craft of product management.

- **Job Description**

**Help shape the future of mobility.**

  

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high\-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.  



  

We’re hiring an Electrical/Electronics Engineer to design and develop our automotive products in the areas of Active Safety and User\-Experience. This position is located in TCI.  



  

**Advanced Software Engineer**

**Position Summary** : Contribute feasibility estimates and safety implementation risks. Refine software safety requirements, detailed design and verification cases. Implement, review, integrate and document safety\-related software. Execute tests, coverage and anomaly closure; provide release evidence. Support safety\-impact analysis and controlled maintenance fixes.  



  

**Your Role:**


	* Implement safety mechanisms, diagnostics, monitoring, fault handling and safe\-state logic.
	* Create detailed design, code, unit tests and required analysis evidence.
	* Apply defensive programming, coding guidelines and freedom\-from\-interference controls.
	* Perform static analysis, structural coverage and fault\-injection support as applicable.
	* Maintain traceability and resolve safety anomalies with documented impact analysis.**Your Background:**

  

	* Exp Level 10Yrs to 12Yrs
	* B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline
	* Embedded C/C\+\+, microcontrollers, AUTOSAR/RTOS and debugging experience.
	* ISO 26262 Part 6 fundamentals, MISRA C/C\+\+, unit testing and static analysis.
	* Requirements traceability, configuration management and Automotive SPICE.
	* Understanding of watchdogs, memory protection, communication monitoring and diagnostics.**Preferred competencies**


	* Model\-based development, MC/DC, fault injection, safety analysis and certified functional\-safety training.**Expected outputs / measures of success**


	* Detailed safety design
	* Production code
	* Unit and coverage evidence
	* Traceability
	* Safety anomaly resolution
	* **NOTE\- Only apply if you meet the basic criteria w.r.t experience \& skill.**  

**Why join us?**

You can grow at Aptiv.Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.


You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.


You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.  



  

**Your Benefits at Aptiv:**

Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);


Life and accident insurance;


Sodexo cards for food and beverages


Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;


EAP Employee Assistance;

Creche facility for working parents

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on—advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission\-critical performance in Aerospace \& Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials \& Robotics and support life\-critical innovation in Medical technologies.


Guided by our winning culture and values to Think \& Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, or Scala
* Strong advanced SQL skills

* AWS cloud technologies: Redshift, S3, Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, IAM, Airflow
* Prior experience in Indian Banking segment and/or Fintech is desired.

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
**About Us** 




 Scapia! A credit card that’s out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for Product Lead to lead our Storefront, Recommendations \& CRM charter.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Build the systems that recognize who a user is and serve them something relevant, on the surfaces that matter, through the channels where they are present.
 



  





 This role owns four connected goals:
 



  





 Maximize LTV through personalized discovery and cross\-sell
 



 Build the recommendations platform that powers contextual discovery across homepage, inner pages, order confirmation, and coin pages. The job is to move users through activation, habit formation, retention, and monetization, not just show them more inventory.
 



  





 Deliver a best\-in\-class app and web experience
 



 Reduce performance and reliability friction across the journey: app size, app start time, crash\-free rate, app load time, app\-open\-to\-home latency, and web metrics (FCP, LCP, landing page optimization). This is the foundation the recommendations platform sits on.
 



  





 Build a unified view of customer intent
 



 Combine behavioral and declared signals into a single, coherent picture of what each user wants and when. This powers personalization today and future monetization surfaces including ads, where Scapia's travel\-financial identity graph becomes something advertisers pay to reach.
 



  





 Own communication as a product surface
 



 Build in\-app notifications and CRM systems that optimize for reach and open rate without degrading user trust. Scapia's new and existing cohorts each need a different message, cadence and channel. Getting it right is one of the highest\-leverage, lowest\-cost retention levers available.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* The recommendations platform roadmap, surfaces, user signals, context and supply signals that go into the models
* App performance and web performance workstreams, partnering closely with platform and infra engineering
* The customer data and signals strategy that unifies behavioral and declared intent
* CRM and in\-app notification systems, including segmentation logic and trust guardrails



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 7\+ years in product management, with at least 2\-3 years owning a recommendations, personalization, or lifecycle marketing system at meaningful scale
* Demonstrated ability to reason about cohorts, not averages: you segment users by behavior and design differently for each segment rather than shipping one experience for everyone
* Working fluency with app performance metrics (crash\-free rate, cold start time) and web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals), even if you haven't personally owned an infra roadmap
* Experience partnering with data science or ML teams on signal design, feature stores, or recommendation models
* A track record of building CRM or notification systems that grew engagement without eroding trust or triggering fatigue/opt\-outs
* Comfort managing PMs and running a multi\-workstream charter, not just a single feature line
* Financial services, travel, or loyalty/rewards experience is a plus, not a requirement

Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.

Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products

 Drive executive\-level decision making by leading COO Monthly Review preparation, delivering critical supply chain insights, responding to senior management analytics requests, and championing AI\-driven automation.  Key responsibilities in your new role

* Answer AdHoc Analysis Request from Senior Management for defined areas (e.g., order mgmt., inventory, allocation)

* 5\+ years of experience in Supply Chain Management, Supply Chain Excellence, Business Analytics, Consulting, or Operations Management.
* Proven experience preparing executive management reviews and senior leadership briefings. Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to derive business insights from complex datasets. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Experience working with reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience with AI, Generative AI, Conversational Agents, or Business Intelligence solutions is a plus.

* Structured and outcome\-oriented working style with excellent attention to detail.
